parsed.reason: Description A says rejected reservations (InventoryError branch) skip pool.release, leaking connections until the pool is exhausted. Description B says non-inventory exceptions skip rollback, leaving partial updates uncommitted on the connection. Both point at the except block in reserve, but they identify different failures: a connection leak on InventoryError versus missing rollback on other exceptions.
